headline: BD (BDX) Stock May Be 19% Undervalued On Fresh MedTech AI Adoption News
summary: Becton Dickinson stock has delivered a 20.9% one year return, yet the valuation checks send a mixed message, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to meaningful upside while market multiples look closer to fair. The 20.9% return over the past year suggests investors have already priced in some optimism, which raises the bar for any further upside to be supported by fundamentals.
